issues.explanation: Deaf or hard-of-hearing users cannot understand audio content in video without synchronized closed captions.
issues.suggestedFixCode:
<video controls>
  <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track kind="captions" src="captions.vtt" srclang="en" label="English Captions">
</video>
issues.quickTip: Always test images & media elements using assistive tools and keyboard navigation.

manualReviewItems.title: Meaningful Alt Text Quality
manualReviewItems.description: Verify image alt text provides equivalent context and meaning, not just superficial image tags.

manualReviewItems.title: Keyboard Focus Order & Visibility
manualReviewItems.description: Navigate the entire site using Tab and Shift+Tab keys to ensure all interactive elements receive visible focus rings in logical order.

manualReviewItems.title: Screen Reader Interaction Testing
manualReviewItems.description: Test interactive dropdowns, modals, and dynamic content updates with NVDA, VoiceOver, or JAWS.

manualReviewItems.title: Responsive Text Scaling (200% Zoom)
manualReviewItems.description: Zoom page to 200% in browser settings and ensure text does not truncate, overlap, or require horizontal scrolling.

performanceImpact.disclaimer: Note: Accessibility improvements support better mobile user experience and search engine discoverability. Measured accessibility scores represent WCAG 2.1 compliance and do not guarantee search engine ranking placement.

impactNotes.title: Mobile Form Completion Rate
impactNotes.benefit: Explicitly associated labels increase touch target area on mobile screens, reducing form abandonment and input frustration.

issues.context: Form element <input name="range"> lacks a associated <label> or aria-label.
issues.originalSnippet: <input data-index="0" aria-valuenow="0" aria-valuetext="0" aria-orientation="horizontal" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuemin="0" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" style="border:0;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);height:100%;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;padding:0;position:absolute;white-space:nowrap;width:100%;direction:ltr" value="0">
issues.explanation: Form controls without labels cannot be announced correctly by screen readers, making forms impossible to complete.
issues.quickTip: Always test forms & controls elements using assistive tools and keyboard navigation.

issues.context: Interactive <button> has no inner text or aria-label attribute.
issues.explanation: Icon buttons or empty buttons without accessible names are announced as "unlabelled button" by screen readers.
issues.quickTip: Always test aria & semantics elements using assistive tools and keyboard navigation.
